tickets.title: Prepare month-by-month tuition schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month schedule showing how much of the Marzipan Meadow charges can come from Elin’s 529, the Teacup Comet tuition set-aside, and the Paper Otter Treasury fund without changing retirement contributions for Mira Quillwhistle. By December 19, 2023.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule by December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain itemized billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized student account PDF from Marzipan Meadow College to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories for Mira Quillwhistle. By December 12, 2023.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the itemized billing packet by December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Resolve 529 balance mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the balance mismatch for Elin Quillwhistle’s 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody (screenshot $67,400 vs. downloaded statement $72,270) for Mira Quillwhistle. By December 15, 2023.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the balance mismatch by December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify payment or reimbursement workflow
tickets.text: Identify the acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for 529 payments to Marzipan Meadow College after the college portal rejected bank verification for Mira Quillwhistle. By December 18, 2023.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to identify the payment or reimbursement workflow by December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a separate education funding projection for Rowan Quillwhistle using the existing 529 balance, expected test and application costs, and a first-year college savings target that does not rely on borrowing for Mira Quillwhistle. By December 29, 2023.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare cost-gap estimate for Rowan
tickets.text: Prepare a cost-gap estimate for Rowan Quillwhistle’s college list before the first school deposit decision so Mira Quillwhistle can compare merit aid offers consistently. By February 2, 2024.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the cost-gap estimate by February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare off-campus housing projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection of which rent, food, and utility amounts for Elin Quillwhistle’s off-campus apartment could fit into the education funding plan versus parent cash flow for Mira Quillwhistle. By January 19, 2024.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare sale-sequencing and tax estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a sale-sequencing and tax estimate for using the Paper Otter taxable education reserve, covering sale sequencing and a tax estimate before using the reserve for Mira Quillwhistle. By January 3, 2024.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-sequencing and tax estimate by January 3, 2024.
